articles.title: Even Justin Verlander has no idea how long he'll pitch in final Tigers start
articles.description: Detroit Tigers pitcher Justin Verlander says he is comfortable throwing 20 pitches in his final start, saying that "there's no script" after that.

articles.title: Justin Verlander: 'I am, and always will be, a Detroit Tiger'
articles.description: Watch some of Justin Verlander's speech as he is honored by Detroit Tigers with pregame celebration ceremony at Comerica Park, Friday, Sept. 25, 2026.

articles.title: Tigers give contract extensions to broadcasters Jason Benetti, Dan Dickerson
articles.description: Jason Benetti is concluding his third season calling games on TV for the Detroit Tigers; Dan Dickerson has been with the Tigers since 2000.

articles.title: Tigers tee off on Nationals to back River Ryan in Detroit debut
articles.description: Right-hander River Ryan made his first Tigers appearance and three of his teammates homered in Monday's beating of the Nationals.

articles.title: Detroit Tigers playoff hopes end with soggy spanking in Chicago
articles.description: Not only did the Tigers' scant playoff hopes officially end in Chicago, but starter Troy Melton left early with an apparent injury.

articles.title: Washington Nationals at Detroit Tigers odds, picks and predictions
articles.description: The Washington Nationals and Detroit Tigers meet Monday to commence a 3-game series. First pitch from Comerica Park in Detroit, Michigan is set for 6:40 p.m. ET.

articles.title: Troy Melton injury update as Tigers RHP says 'twinges' chased him
articles.description: Detroit Tigers righty Troy Melton exited Sunday in the fourth inning in Chicago, but he said he doesn't think it's a serious arm injury.

articles.title: Costly replay puts Tigers on brink of elimination with L to White Sox
articles.description: A replay review in the sixth inning negated what would have been the tying run for the Tigers, who lost to the White Sox.

articles.title: Justin Verlander to start Saturday for Tigers in final appearance
articles.description: Detroit Tigers legend Justin Verlander will pitch the final game of his career in Comerica Park vs Pittsburgh Pirates on Saturday, Sept. 26.

articles.title: Detroit Tigers 2027 core already connecting in wild win over White Sox
articles.description: The Detroit Tigers' 2026 has been far from pleasant, but in topping the White Sox in a wild rally, they showed the blueprint for 2027.
